gloss: legs and lower back; lower body strength

definitions.gloss: legs and lower back; lower body strength
definitions.explanation: The legs and lower back considered as a functional unit, especially regarding physical strength and mobility.

examples.japanese: {足腰|あしこし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}く→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My legs and lower back have gotten weaker.

examples.japanese: {足腰|あしこし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to strengthen your lower body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{九十歳|きゅうじゅっさい}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{足腰|あしこし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっかりしている→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother is ninety, but her legs and lower back are still strong.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{足腰|あしこし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Walking every day makes your lower body strong.

notes:
Refers to the legs and lower back as a unit, especially in the context of physical strength and mobility. A compound of ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ (legs) and ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧ (lower back/hips). Often used when discussing aging, fitness, or physical condition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {足腰|あしこし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: to have strong legs and back
- {足腰|あしこし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧: to have weak legs and back
- {足腰|あしこし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧: to train/strengthen the lower body
- {足腰|あしこし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっかりしている→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧: to be physically sturdy
- {足腰|あしこし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}たない→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to be unable to stand (from exhaustion or weakness)

USAGE:
Very commonly used in health and fitness contexts, and when describing elderly people's physical condition. It emphasizes the functional unity of the lower body rather than individual parts.
